summary: The filing reports the closure of a €900M 4.500% Senior Notes due 2033 offering by an indirect wholly-owned subsidiary of Birkenstock Holding plc. The notes are unsecured senior obligations used primarily to refinance €428.5M of existing 5.25% notes and potentially fund discretionary share repurchases. The offering was conducted under Rule 144A/Reg S and is not a special situation; it is a routine debt refinancing and capital management transaction. No change of control, acquisition, divestiture, or strategic event is triggered. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer report on Form 6-K.
